causal_assessment.condition_behavior: wait_active checks _events and _done under the same Condition used by _record to append and notify. The observed error is raised only when _events remains empty and _done false at its deadline check.
causal_assessment.deadline_anchors: wait_active starts its own monotonic deadline when called. The native timeout is set in the observer thread after Popen and pipe setup, not at the same admission timestamp.
causal_assessment.final_event_limit: The final loan_started record proves eventual selected-entry observation. It has no host arrival timestamp and does not establish availability before the 5-second deadline.
causal_assessment.five_seconds_binding: Hardcoded in the registered producer/probe source snapshot, not a separate configurable field in profile JSON.
not_proved: No root cause among process startup, OS scheduling, observer-thread scheduling or pipe I/O can be selected from these records.
No lost-wakeup race is demonstrated by the reviewed Condition code.
No zero-risk proof or general backend/resource-ledger correctness follows from this finite execution.

driver_main_cost.scope: Main entry through final source/tool checks; excludes module imports, final summary serialization and caller overhead. Child step wall values are nested in this duration, not additive.

  %b1 = insertvalue %hia.buffer %b0, i64 %length, 1
  %r0 = insertvalue %hia.alloc zeroinitializer, %hia.buffer %b1, 0
  %r1 = insertvalue %hia.alloc %r0, i1 true, 1
